/* REQ: LANG-2191 LANG-2192 LANG-2193 LANG-2194
*/
/* Memory layout */
ENTRY(_start)
MEMORY
{
  FLASH (rx) : ORIGIN = 0x08000000, LENGTH = 512K
  RAM (rwx)  : ORIGIN = 0x20000000, LENGTH = 128K
}
SECTIONS
{
  .text : { KEEP(*(.vectors)) *(.text*) } > FLASH
  .data : { *(.data*) } > RAM AT > FLASH
  _end = .;
}
